title: Villarroel on multiple transients appearing and vanishing

tellings.quote: Sometimes you can see multiple of them appearing and vanishing within half an hour.

plain: On photographs of the night sky taken at the Palomar Observatory in California between 1949 and 1957, points of light called transients show up on one plate and are gone on the next, and sometimes "you can see multiple of them appearing and vanishing within half an hour." The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, who studies these old plates, tells Michels this. If the lights are real objects, something bright was in the sky near Earth before any satellite was launched.
